sense: in a play or a game

terms.gloss: a part, a role (of an actor)
evidence: Ter. Phorm. 27: prīmās partēs quī aget, is erit Phormiō
terms.comment: partēs agere, to play a part; prīmās partēs agere, to play the lead.
The character an actor represents, and the mask he wears for it.

phrases.latin: Quia, prīmās partēs quī aget, is erit Phormiō parasītus, per quem rēs agētur maximē
phrases.english: because the leading part will be played by Phormio, the parasite, through whom most of the plot is carried on

sources: Lewis & Short: pars · Lewis & Short: persona
Terence’s Phormio and Eunuchus checked against the Perseus Latin texts (9 November 2026).
